steps.hardClue: Travel through the teleporter and activate three reactors to restore power.
steps.clue: Travel to Omega Base and activate the three Aether Reactors to restore power.

steps.hardClue: Obtain an ID badge, mix three compounds and pump the truth serum into the scientist’s office.
steps.clue: Obtain Ravenov’s ID Badge, create the truth serum and pump it into Peck’s office.

steps.hardClue: Capture three specific enemies and recover their memories to obtain a disk.
steps.clue: Capture the three required Mimics with Essence Traps to obtain the Floppy Disk.

steps.hardClue: Insert the disk into the computer to open the sealed portal chamber.
steps.clue: Insert the Floppy Disk into the computer to open the Omega Portal Chamber.

steps.hardClue: Dig up three crystal canisters and complete their different challenges.
steps.clue: Use the Aethermeter, shovel and RAI K-84 to recover the three Aetherium Crystal canisters.

steps.hardClue: Place the three crystal canisters inside the reactors and return to the portal.
steps.clue: Place the Aetherium Crystal canisters inside the three Aether Reactors and return to the OPC.

steps.hardClue: Use the computer to align the dish with the unidentified satellite.
steps.clue: Align the satellite dish with Requiem’s satellite.

steps.hardClue: Activate the portal and rescue the trapped operative.
steps.clue: Activate the OPC portal and rescue Samantha Maxis.

steps.hardClue: Return to the starting village and defeat the giant creature.
steps.clue: Return to the Village and defeat Orda.
